title: Worst-Day Triage Stack Rank
dataSources: Daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`), personal SLO status (`personalslo:status`), cross-signal correlations (`correlation:pair`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The meta layer — correlating every `index=personal` feed (sleep, activity, mood, weather, spend, productivity, home telemetry) into daily life scores, personal SLOs, and cross-signal anomaly detection, all computed in Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifescore:daily
| where score<=4
| stats avg(stress_score) as stress_score, avg(sleep_score) as sleep_score, avg(recovery_score) as recovery_score, count as rough_days
description: Summarises the factors that most commonly accompany your worst-scoring days.
value: A triage view of bad days helps you intervene on the strongest contributors instead of guessing.
implementation: Publish daily life scores with stress, sleep, and recovery contributors; aggregate the mix for low-score days.
visualization: Single scorecard of average stress, sleep, and recovery values on rough days.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces what your worst days usually have in common, so you know where to start fixing the pattern.
